status.errorTitle: Your browser's storage is full or unavailable
status.keptTitle: Changes not yet saved to the file are kept in this browser, so a reload or crash loses nothing

file.deletedTitle: The file was deleted or moved: Save asks where to save
file.dirtyTitle: Press {{key}} to write your changes to the file

editor.reloaded: Reloaded from disk. Your text was kept as a version (see History).
editor.splitTitle: Show a second document (or this one) side by side (Ctrl/Cmd+\)
editor.saveToFolderTitle: Save this draft as a file in an open folder
editor.inTrash: This document is in the Trash. Restore it to keep it in your list.
editor.changedConflict: “{{name}}” changed on disk, and you have changes not saved to it. Reload to take the file's text (yours is kept in History), or keep yours (Save will ask before replacing the file).
editor.deletedOnDisk: “{{name}}” was deleted or moved on disk. Your text is still here; Save asks where to save it.
editor.storageFailed: Not saved. Your browser's storage is full or unavailable, so these changes will be lost when you close this tab. Download a copy, or free space by deleting other documents and emptying the Trash.
editor.showDetailsTitle: Show encoding, line endings, language, indentation and text size
editor.mixedTitle: Each line keeps its own ending; new lines get {{eol}}
editor.problemsTitle: Show the problems (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+M; F8 goes to the next one)

settings.intro: Settings apply at once and are kept in this browser. A document's own choices (from its status bar) come first.
settings.fontNote: A font must be installed on this computer; if it isn't, the system's monospace font is used.
settings.vimNote: Normal, insert and visual modes, motions, operators, registers, :w to save… The mode shows under the text. Shortcuts with Ctrl/Cmd still work.
settings.indentNote: For files whose indentation can't be detected and whose type has no convention (Python uses 4 spaces, Go and Makefiles tabs).
settings.wrapProse: Wrap long lines in prose (text, Markdown)
settings.closeBrackets: Close brackets and quotes in code
settings.autocomplete: Suggestions while typing in code (Ctrl+Space always works)
settings.lint: Check JSON and YAML for mistakes
settings.liveReloadNote: When a file changes outside Plumb, its document takes the new text, unless you have changes not saved to it: then you choose. Off: you're asked each time.
settings.editorConfigNote: For files opened from a folder, .editorconfig files decide indentation, trailing whitespace and the final newline (indent_style, indent_size, tab_width, trim_trailing_whitespace, insert_final_newline), ahead of the settings above.

history.restored: Restored the version from {{when}}. The text it replaced was kept as a version.
history.label: Version history
history.title: History
history.saveVersionTitle: Keep the current text as a version, with a name if you like
history.memoryOnly: This browser can't use IndexedDB, so versions are kept only until this page is closed.
history.empty: No versions yet. One is kept when you open a file, every few minutes while you edit, and when you save to a file or press Save version.

labels.selectNext: Add the next occurrence to the selection
labels.clickCursor: Add a cursor / select a block

welcome.title: Welcome to Plumb
welcome.files: Files stay on your disk. Open a file or a folder, edit it, and Save ({{key}}) writes it back. Until then, your edits are kept in this browser.
welcome.filesDownload: Files stay on your disk. Open a file or a folder, edit it, and Save ({{key}}) writes it back as a download. Until then, your edits are kept in this browser.
welcome.drafts: Drafts live in this browser. New document starts one: notes, pasted text, anything that isn't a file yet. They're saved as you type.
welcome.private: Nothing leaves your computer. No account, no server; it works offline.
welcome.hint: Drop files anywhere on this page to open them. Press {{key}} to find anything, F1 for all the shortcuts.

home.noDrafts: No drafts yet. Create one, open a file, or drop files anywhere on this page.
home.noLabelled: No drafts have this label any more.
home.pinTitle: Pin to the top of the list
home.storageLocal: Documents are kept in this browser's small localStorage (about 5 MB) because IndexedDB isn't available.
home.storage: Documents are kept in this browser.
home.storageUsage: Documents are kept in this browser · {{used}} used of {{quota}} available.
home.storageNotPersisted: The browser may clear them if the disk gets full: export a backup now and then.
home.trashNote_one: Documents in the Trash are deleted forever after {{count}} day.
home.trashNote_other: Documents in the Trash are deleted forever after {{count}} days.

search.emptyFolders: Type to search every document and every file in your open folders. Click a result to open it there.

find.replaceRegexHelp: Use $1, $2… or $<name> for groups, $& for the whole match, $$ for a $; \n and \t for a new line and tab
